# Decisions: push-ping-reach

- 2026-09-14T17:37:27.677Z — chose **The push ping names any LIVE session a carried record knows, open or already written back. Liveness comes from the host registry plus kill(pid,0), not from the record's open set. Amends SPEC §Acceptance criteria, which says the ping is silent when the other record has no open session.** over Keeping the ping open-sessions-only, and adding a Sofar-Session trailer so only the sessions that authored the commits get named (commit-attribution D17 already rejected that trailer). because In splen on 2026-09-14, both peers had written back 3 and 28 minutes before a sibling's push, so the ping had nobody to name. Finishing, committing and leaving the push to a sibling is the normal flow, and it is exactly when a live window needs to hear its work shipped. Registry liveness already filters out dead sessions, so the only extra reach is to idle windows that can still act on the news.
